rules: Pass-1 overrides are evaluated before need-based routes.
Uncertainty about a life-threatening or environmental hazard escalates rather than reassures.
A modifier changes logistics and access; it does not cancel urgency.
Every diagram is a view of this registry, never the only route.

accessible-emergency-place.label: accessible emergency accommodation or powered destination

overrides.trigger: Possible death, abnormal breathing, unconsciousness, severe bleeding, stroke sign, major injury, or lasting harm
overrides.action: Call 112 now; use speakerphone and follow the dispatcher.
overrides.backup: If you cannot call, direct a named person to call or use another available emergency channel.
overrides.escalation: Yes, maybe, cannot tell, or the person is worsening.

overrides.trigger: Active violence, coercion, stalking at the door, or a crime requiring police now
overrides.action: Move toward a safer place without confronting the threat; call 110 when safe to do so.
overrides.backup: Use 112 when medical rescue is also needed or life may be in danger.
overrides.escalation: Threat is present, access is blocked, a weapon is involved, or anyone is injured.

overrides.trigger: Fire, visible smoke, a smoke alarm, or smoke in an escape route
overrides.action: Warn others and leave by a smoke-free route; close doors behind you when this does not delay escape.
overrides.backup: If the route is smoky, do not enter it; close the door, call 112, state your location, and signal at a window.
overrides.escalation: Any uncontrolled fire, smoke, trapped person, symptoms, or uncertainty.

overrides.trigger: CO alarm or compatible symptoms near a heater, boiler, stove, generator, fire, or other combustion source
overrides.action: Get everyone into fresh air immediately without delaying to search for the source.
overrides.backup: Call 112 from outside and prevent re-entry until the scene is cleared.
overrides.escalation: Alarm, symptoms, collapse, confusion, headache affecting several people, or suspected combustion exposure.

overrides.trigger: Gas odour, hissing, damaged gas line, or suspected gas release inside a building
overrides.action: Use no flame, switch, plug, bell, fan, or phone inside; warn by knocking and leave.
overrides.backup: Open doors or windows only when immediately reachable without operating equipment or delaying escape; call outside.
overrides.escalation: Strong or persistent odour, hissing, symptoms, damaged line, or uncertainty.

overrides.trigger: Unknown fumes, mixed cleaners, chemical splash, eye or skin exposure, or swallowed product
overrides.action: Stop the exposure and move to fresh air when safe; rinse exposed skin or eyes with running water and remove contaminated clothing.
overrides.backup: Keep the label or container and call a poison centre for substance-specific advice; do not induce vomiting or improvise neutralization.
overrides.escalation: Breathing difficulty, altered consciousness, severe pain, seizure, collapse, extensive exposure, or rapid worsening.

overrides.trigger: Live current, sparking, burning electrical equipment, damaged cable, or a person still connected to electricity
overrides.action: Do not touch the person or source while it may be live; disconnect power only from a safely reachable control.
overrides.backup: Leave the danger area and call 112; keep others away.
overrides.escalation: Any electrical injury, fire, smoke, high-voltage source, wet environment, or inability to isolate power.

needs.label: Responsibility / harm
needs.action: Stabilize the live problem, then make one repair step.
needs.backup: Bring in a trusted person or relevant service.
needs.escalation: A dependant is unsafe or harm is continuing.

needs.label: Panic / overload
needs.action: Orient outward and choose one visible action.
needs.backup: Contact one person and use a non-breath-focused grounding option.
needs.escalation: New medical red flag, self-harm risk, or inability to stay safe.

needs.label: Body / pain
needs.action: Check red flags, then use simple first aid.
needs.escalation: Sudden, severe, neurological, chest, breathing, bleeding, or collapse signs.

needs.label: Threat / no safe place
needs.action: Use the Situation G safe-place classifier and secure the next safe hour.
needs.backup: Use a staffed public place and tell one person where you are while contacting the matching service.
needs.escalation: Violence, exposure, medical danger, acute self-harm risk, or a failed essential-care bridge.

needs.label: Smell / household hazard
needs.action: Use the environmental-hazard classifier before troubleshooting.
needs.backup: Leave the source area and call from outside.
needs.escalation: Fire, smoke, gas, electricity, chemicals, symptoms, or uncertainty.

needs.label: Outage / disruption
needs.action: Protect air, medication, essential devices, water, temperature, and information in that order.
needs.backup: Move to a powered or staffed location using the household continuity plan.
needs.escalation: A device or treatment cannot be safely bridged, or official instructions require evacuation.

modifiers.label: alone
modifiers.preparation: Identify one check-in person and a way responders can enter.
modifiers.failure_escalation: You cannot call, move, unlock, or monitor safely.

modifiers.label: infant or child
modifiers.preparation: Keep age-specific supplies, caregiver contacts, and transport ready.
modifiers.failure_escalation: The child is difficult to wake, breathing abnormally, or cannot be kept warm/safe.

modifiers.label: pregnancy or postpartum
modifiers.preparation: Keep maternity contacts, medication list, and a transport plan.
modifiers.failure_escalation: Heavy bleeding, seizure, severe breathlessness, collapse, or acute psychiatric danger.

modifiers.label: mobility, vision, hearing, or cognitive access
modifiers.preparation: Plan transfer help, communication cards, alarms, and an accessible exit.
modifiers.failure_escalation: The person cannot leave or communicate without immediate assistance.

modifiers.label: essential medication
modifiers.preparation: Keep a current list, refill path, storage requirement, and agreed reserve.
modifiers.failure_escalation: A critical dose or storage condition cannot be maintained.

modifiers.label: powered medical device
modifiers.preparation: Record power draw, battery runtime, backup source, supplier, and powered destination.
modifiers.failure_escalation: Life-supporting function is interrupted or remaining runtime cannot cover transfer.

modifiers.label: animal
modifiers.preparation: Prepare carrier, lead, medication, food, records, and a backup carer.
modifiers.failure_escalation: The animal cannot be moved without endangering people or is acutely ill.

modifiers.label: language or speech access
modifiers.preparation: Keep a short written emergency card and preferred communication method.

modifiers.label: no transport
modifiers.preparation: Name one accessible destination and two transport options.
modifiers.failure_escalation: Official evacuation or essential treatment cannot be reached.

safe_place_routes.trigger: A person, stalker, controller, or active crime makes the current place unsafe
safe_place_routes.action: Move toward a safer place without confrontation; use 110 for active police danger and 112 for medical or life danger.
safe_place_routes.backup: Use 116 016, the violence-against-men helpline, or a specialist refuge route from a safer device or location.
safe_place_routes.escalation: The threat is present, access is blocked, a weapon is involved, a child is endangered, or anyone is injured.

safe_place_routes.trigger: There is no lawful, weather-safe place to sleep tonight and no immediate violence route
safe_place_routes.action: Contact municipal emergency accommodation, social services, or the local after-hours authority; state tonight’s need and all access or care constraints.
safe_place_routes.backup: During 115 service hours, use 115 to identify the responsible authority; while arranging help, move to a staffed, weather-protected public place when possible.
safe_place_routes.escalation: Exposure, severe weather, illness, pregnancy/postpartum danger, a child without safe care, or inability to maintain essential treatment.

safe_place_routes.trigger: A nominal place exists but cannot safely support mobility, communication, medication, powered equipment, pregnancy, a child, or another essential dependency
safe_place_routes.action: Name the exact barrier and remaining safe runtime; request an accessible place, transport, power, refrigeration, caregiver, or communication support.
safe_place_routes.backup: Contact the care team, supplier, 116 117, municipal service, or accessible destination before the safe reserve is exhausted.
safe_place_routes.escalation: Life-supporting function is interrupted, transfer cannot finish in time, or the person cannot leave or communicate safely.

safe_place_routes.trigger: The place is physically safe, but social rupture, overload, panic, or internal crisis makes staying unworkable
safe_place_routes.action: Secure one hour: choose one ally, one staffed place or quiet exit, and one concrete next contact.
safe_place_routes.backup: Use 116 123, 116 111 for children and young people, 116 117, or a local crisis service.
safe_place_routes.escalation: Acute self-harm or other danger, severe confusion, loss of reality contact, exposure, or inability to remain safe.
